title: Progress in the design of ascorbic acid derivative-mediated drug delivery
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37482-37510
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03825A, Review Article

Caroline Lamie, Enas Elmowafy, Dalia A. Attia, Nahed D. Mortada
Vitamin C derivatives—ascorbyl-6 palmitate and ascorbyl-2 glucoside—are incorporated into advanced lipid-based circular vesicles, improving vitamin C's bioavailability, stability, and penetration, and the prospects for pharmaceutical and cosmetic application of vitamin C's antioxidant properties.
